title: Aye Bhai zara bhai hame kehke
body:
jis waqt gire ghode se abbas-e-dilawar
shai kehte the roro ke maqtal ki zameen par
aakha kaha maula kaha tumne aye baradar
<<MINI>>
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
ek baar bas ek baar aqee kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
1. hain dil pe mere kitne zakham kaise batao
tazaa hain sabhi zakhm -e- jigar kaise batao
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
2. hain naqsh mere dil pe wo qasim ka janaza
kis tarha uthaya wo qasim ka janaza
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
3. sone ki jagah payee hai kya khoob tarayi
pyaase rahe darya pe wafa khoob nibhayi
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
4. aakha kaha maula kaha aye jaane baradar
duniya se chale tum pe qurban baradar
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
5. jaate ho mujhe chodke tanha mere bhai
chin jayegi zainab ki rida ab mere bhai
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
6. sojati thi jo chain se jage gi wo aankhe
jo khauf se soti na thi soyengi wo aankhe
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
7. jal jayengey khaime na amaa payegi zainab
kunbe ko liye shaam talak jayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
8. pyaasi rahi naazon ki pali rote ho bhai kyun mu ko chupaye huwe ab rote ho bhai
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
9. toote gi kamar marne se tere
aye baradar
reh jaunga tanha bina tere aye baradar
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
10. hai meri tamanna ke pukaro mujhe bhai
juzz tere siwaa sab ne pukara mujhe bhai
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
11. iss lafz ko sunne ko tarasta hi raha hoon
bhai mujhe kehdo ke tadapta hi raha hoon
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
12. bhai kaha aur margaye poori huwi nusrat
maula ki tamanna thi jo poori huwi sarwat
<<MINI>>
ek baar bas ek bar aqee kehke pukaro
aye bhai zara bhai hume kehke pukaro
